_note: The verifier ledger: what makes a GREEN week in containment/GATE-LEDGER.json something other than a hand-typed string. Each GREEN week must appear here with a verifier, a date and a non-empty list of evidence paths that exist on disk; scripts/gates/gate-verify.ts fails an entry whose evidence is missing and fails a GREEN week with no entry at all. A week is verified by pointing at the artefacts that are the proof, not by asserting the proof in prose.
